notes: The Lighter Flotilla by day, aboard the longboat (the one sea hull here). Call the Wind is a lesser power, already known; the melee kit holds a sword and a steel shield in hand. The power goes into the power slot, never a hand (Skyrim), and the power key casts it with the shield still held; the wind pick opens, south is picked, and the trees, the water and the sail swing to the new wind. From the cast on, the capture camera stands 8 m out to sea (south-east, bearing 150) looking back past the sail at the shore trees 26-36 m north-west, so the swing is in shot before and after the pick. The boarding is an unfilmed lead-in; the hull is taken, not bought (the buy is proved by boat-sea-wind).

steps.name: board
steps.transition: at the longboat's mooring, E: the player climbs aboard the flotilla's sea hull and takes the helm (taken, not bought)

steps.name: ready-the-power
steps.transition: magic window -> Call the Wind in the power slot; the shield stays in the left hand

steps.name: use-the-power
steps.transition: the power key (Z) aboard: Call the Wind casts with the shield held, the wind pick opens

steps.name: pick-the-wind
steps.transition: wind pick -> south: the trees, the water and the sail swing to a south wind
